title: Host Network Visibility (netprobe) Configuration
description: Operator-facing netprobe config. Toggle Enabled to turn on eBPF process attribution — no other fields are required. The capture / DPI / device-binding fields are optional and only needed for passive packet fingerprinting. Mirrors proto agent.netprobe.v1.VisibilityAgentConfig.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When on, netprobe runs eBPF process attribution (the flow-to-process source behind attributed flows); packet capture/DPI additionally engage only if capture interfaces or device bindings are set below.

capture_interfaces.title: Capture interfaces
capture_interfaces.description: Allowlist of NIC names to capture on. Empty means no interfaces are captured.

default_sample_interval_ms.title: Default sample interval (ms)
default_sample_interval_ms.description: Default per-device fingerprint sampling interval; overridable per device binding.

flow_table_max_entries.title: Flow table max entries
flow_table_max_entries.description: Upper bound on the in-memory flow table. 0 means auto (interface count x 65536).

process_snapshot_interval_s.title: Process snapshot interval (s)
process_snapshot_interval_s.description: How often eBPF process-attribution snapshots are emitted.

external_flow_match_window_ms.title: External flow match window (ms)
external_flow_match_window_ms.description: Temporal window for matching external (non-process) flows by 5-tuple.
